VAE_extension.KL_warmup: linear from 0 to 0.01 over the first 0.25 of fixed/training epochs
VAE_extension.prior: independent standard normal for shared and private latent variables
VAE_extension.reparameterization: standard Gaussian reparameterization trick on CUDA

V0_BALANCED_AE.prespecified_component_hypothesis: Block normalization prevents methylation dominance and improves held-out reconstruction fairness.

V1_SHARED_PRIVATE_AE.prespecified_component_hypothesis: Shared/private decomposition separates cross-view structure from assay-specific variation.

V2_CONTRASTIVE_SPAE.prespecified_component_hypothesis: Paired contrastive alignment improves same-patient cross-view retrieval.

V3_DROPOUT_SPAE.prespecified_component_hypothesis: Modality dropout improves partial-view robustness and RNA-only projection.

V4_SABLE_MO.prespecified_component_hypothesis: The stability gate removes attractive but non-reproducible latent factors.

V5_SABLE_VAE.prespecified_component_hypothesis: The variational extension tests whether posterior regularization improves generalization despite the small sample size.

block_balanced_reconstruction.aggregate: unweighted mean of normalized view losses
block_balanced_reconstruction.null_error: fit-subset MSE from predicting the zero/mean PCA vector for that view
block_balanced_reconstruction.per_view_MSE: mean squared error in the fold-local PCA coordinate system

decoder.V1_to_V5_observed_view_input: concatenate(patient shared embedding, own private embedding)
decoder.body: Linear(latent_input, hidden_dim) -> LayerNorm -> GELU -> Linear(hidden_dim, PCA_dim)
decoder.missing_view_input: concatenate(patient shared embedding from available views, zero private vector for the omitted target view)

early_stopping.monitor: deterministic early-stop total objective evaluated with modality dropout disabled; V3-V5 missing-view term is evaluated by systematic leave-one-view-out reconstruction
early_stopping.refit: after epoch selection, reinitialize with the same frozen fit seed and refit on fit + early-stop samples for exactly the selected epoch count

encoder.V1_to_V4_output: separate shared and private latent heads
encoder.V5_output: shared mean/log-variance and private mean/log-variance heads

fold_local_preprocessing.PCA: deterministic training-fold dual PCA with sign orientation
fold_local_preprocessing.effective_PCA_components: min(profile component target, n_training - 1, numerical matrix rank)
fold_local_preprocessing.scaling: training-fold mean and sample standard deviation after imputation

heavy_computation_device_policy: All neural forward passes, backward passes, optimizer steps, contrastive similarity matrices, reconstruction losses, and latent projections must execute on CUDA. Quiet CPU fallback is forbidden.

missing_view_reconstruction_loss.training_target: deliberately dropped target modality in PCA space

modality_dropout.randomness: CUDA torch.Generator seeded by the frozen fit seed and epoch
modality_dropout.rule: with the frozen profile probability, independently mark a patient for dropout and remove exactly one uniformly sampled modality; never drop all modalities

paired_contrastive_loss.formula: symmetric full-batch InfoNCE over L2-normalized per-view shared embeddings; same patient is the positive and all other patients in the fit batch are negatives

parameter_initialization.linear_weights: torch.nn.init.xavier_uniform_ using the frozen fit seed

private_separation_loss.formula: mean squared Frobenius norm of centered cross-view private cross-covariance across available ordered view pairs

shared_alignment_loss.formula: mean squared distance from each available per-view shared embedding to the patient shared mean

shared_private_orthogonality_loss.formula: mean squared Frobenius norm of centered shared-private cross-covariance within each available view

shared_representation.missing_view_rule: dropped or unavailable views are excluded from the shared mean
shared_representation.patient_shared_embedding: arithmetic mean of available per-view shared embeddings

stability_gate.alignment: orthogonal Procrustes on shared scores, then Hungarian factor matching and sign orientation
stability_gate.modality_support_energy: squared L2 norm of the shared-dimension column in each view's first decoder affine layer, normalized across views
stability_gate.rotational_rule: if factor_level_identifiable=false but subspace_level_identifiable=true, report and gate the shared subspace; individual-factor claims are forbidden

technical_confound_simulation_status.false_biological_acceptance: stable nontechnical factor that fails biological truth matching
technical_confound_simulation_status.technical_flag_rule: stable factor with absolute correlation >= 0.50 to known technical simulation truth is labeled stable_technical_flag
